outline.heading: 1. What is Product-Led SEO (and Why Content-Only Models Stall)?
outline.section_purpose: Define product-led SEO, contrast it with traditional top-of-funnel blog posts, and demonstrate how product usage data fuels organic discovery.
key_talking_points: Traditional content marketing vs product-driven organic indexing.
The mechanics of indexable product artifacts (templates, calculators, public boards).
How self-serve flywheels reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC).
questions_answered: How does product-led SEO differ from traditional content marketing?
What makes a product feature indexable for search engines?
evidence_needs: Cite comparative CAC data between sales-led and product-led SaaS motions (human verification needed).

outline.heading: 2. The Three Archetypes of Product-Led Search Surfaces
outline.section_purpose: Deconstruct the primary architectural patterns successful SaaS brands use to capture organic intent.
key_talking_points: Template Libraries: How Miro, Notion, and Canva dominate high-intent keywords.
Public Data Directories & Teardowns: G2, Zapier app directories, and Figma community pages.
Interactive Calculators & Tools: High-intent problem-solving utilities.
questions_answered: Which product features generate the most search-driven signups?
How can engineering and marketing collaborate on programmatic landing pages?
evidence_needs: Reference verified public page count statistics for leading template directories.

outline.heading: 3. Designing Indexable Product Experiences Without Cannibalizing UX
outline.section_purpose: Provide actionable technical and UX safeguards to keep product-led pages user-friendly and crawlable.
key_talking_points: Server-side rendering (SSR) requirements for product catalog pages.
Balancing gated content vs search bot discoverability.
Canonicalization and handling faceted navigation parameter bloat.
questions_answered: Should product templates be ungated for Googlebot?
How do you prevent crawl budget waste on dynamic product paths?
evidence_needs: Verify Google Search Central documentation on rendering JavaScript-heavy web applications.

outline.heading: 4. Attribution & Measuring Product-Qualified Leads (PQLs) From Search
outline.section_purpose: Explain how growth teams track organic traffic downstream to product adoption and activation.
key_talking_points: Moving beyond vanity traffic to product activation rate.
Tracking signups directly from interactive widgets vs editorial articles.
Attribution models suitable for hybrid self-serve and sales-assist cycles.
questions_answered: How do you tie organic search rankings to SaaS revenue?
What metrics define a successful product-led SEO initiative?
evidence_needs: Verify standard PQL conversion benchmarks from reputable SaaS survey data.

outline.heading: 5. Step-by-Step Implementation Checklist for Growth Teams
outline.section_purpose: Summarize tactical next steps for launching a pilot product-led SEO experiment.
key_talking_points: Audit existing product artifacts for indexability.
Map user intent keywords to existing customer workflows.
Ship an MVP template directory with 20 core use cases.
questions_answered: Where should a team start with zero programmatic infrastructure?
evidence_needs: Verify team bandwidth requirements for initial MVP rollout.

evidence_checklist.claim_or_fact: Googlebot rendering limitations for client-side rendered Single Page Applications (SPAs).
evidence_checklist.required_source_type: Official Google Search Central Technical Documentation.

evidence_checklist.claim_or_fact: Conversion benchmarks for template-based landing pages vs standard blog posts.
evidence_checklist.required_source_type: Verified Case Study or Primary Analytics Telemetry.
evidence_checklist.verification_guidance: Ensure any quoted conversion percentage cites a named SaaS company case study with published dates.
